arguments.value: The agreement is between Modus Media International (MMI) and Dragon Systems, Inc. It says MMI will provide turnkey production and related services for Dragon Systems, initially for three products, including handling master materials, supply base management, production, delivery, inventory management, and financial services, with service levels to be agreed. Dragon Systems may reject services that do not meet the agreed specifications, and services are deemed accepted if no notice of noncompliance is given within 60 days after delivery. Dragon Systems will pay MMI according to the attached price sheets and Annex "Prices" in U.S. dollars, with invoices based on actual shipments performed; the source also says MMI may charge an inventory carriage fee on stock older than 90 days, but the exact omitted amount is redacted. MMI warrants that it will perform the services with due care and that the services will not infringe third-party intellectual property rights; if there is a defect within 6 months of delivery, Dragon Systems may require re-performance, rescind the contract, refuse payment in part or in full, and MMI must defend and indemnify Dragon Systems against patent or copyright claims if notified promptly and given control of the defense. Both parties must keep confidential information secret, Dragon Systems grants MMI a license to copy master materials as needed for forecasted quantities, and MMI must maintain insurance for Dragon Systems property in its care and notify Dragon Systems of any theft, loss, or damage. The agreement lasts for an indefinite period. Either party may terminate immediately for a material breach, merger or change of key management or control, or bankruptcy or a similar event, and Dragon Systems may also terminate without cause on 60 days' written notice. Governing law/jurisdiction: lawsuits may be brought in a State or Federal Court in Massachusetts or in a court in the Netherlands with jurisdiction.
